body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 677d62f3c71ba1e156757cf81f709e1d17094da1 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers found.

Note on the build: main does not build right now (#844). This review was built and tested on PR + main + the pending #844 fix (mkinney 2c05183c). The PR head itself does not compile against main without that fix, and that is not a finding against this PR.

**What looks good**
- Trial merge with current main is textually clean (no conflicts). `MERGEABLE`.
- No snapshot PNGs changed (`crates/ui/tests/snapshots` untouched). The new PNGs under `docs/images/` are documentation pictures, not goldens.
- No process files touched (`AGENTS.md`, `.claude/`, `xtask/`, `.cargo/`, `scripts/`, `build.rs`, `.github/`), so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is needed. No new dependencies.
- `examples/first-part.camproj` version 58 matches `PROJECT_VERSION` (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs:80`).
- The docs test is not `#[ignore]`d and needs no `--ignored` lane. It runs in the existing `gpu_render` binary and shares its GPU lock, as the body says.
- The generator script `examples/models/gen_first_part_obj.py` is stdlib-only (`import sys`), has no network or subprocess use, and self-checks watertightness before writing. Its header states the part is an authored clean-room fixture. I did not run it (reviewer rule: no scripts from the PR).
- Body has no closing keyword (`Fixes`/`Closes`/`Resolves`); it references #291 only as an umbrella.

**Local results (PR + main + #844 fix, tree `8319e01d`)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test gpu_render` | 11 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored (includes `docs_images_match_the_rendered_steps`) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 480 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

PR + main without #844: `camcraft-motion` lib fails with 7 errors in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_slot.rs` (E0308/E0609). Not this PR's code.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. `crates/ui/src/interact.rs:775` doc comment points at `crates/ui/tests/docs_images.rs`, which does not exist; the harness is `crates/ui/tests/gpu_render.rs:575`. A one-word fix at the maintainer's or the author's convenience.
2. `docs_images_match_the_rendered_steps` returns early with only an `eprintln!` when no GPU adapter is found (`gpu_render.rs` around 637-668), so on a GPU-less machine it passes without comparing anything. `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1` turns that into a failure; worth setting in the release lane.
3. `crates/ui/tests/gpu_render.rs` is now 715 lines (430 on main, already over the ~400 guideline before this PR). Test file, so not blocking; a split would be nice later.
4. `examples/first-part.nc` (281 lines) is not regenerated or compared by any test. Only the project is loaded (by the docs test); the NC can drift from the project without a failure. Consider a test that re-posts the project and compares the NC, or a note that it is a snapshot.
5. The PR body still says "Keeping this draft until the open questions in #291 are answered", but the PR is flagged ready. Consider updating the body so it matches.
6. The PR has no `Changelog:` line. Docs-only, so `Changelog: none` would be enough.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
